'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Kendall Halman LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kendall Halman]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kendall Halman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
